Description: Mile Limit offers a thoughtfully curated selection of boutique wines from underrepresented winemakers, including people of color, LGBTQ, and immigrants. Open Wednesday through Sunday from 12 PM to 6 PM, it’s the perfect place to explore unique, small-batch wines for any occasion. Whether you're picking up a bottle to enjoy at home or seeking something new, Mile Limit brings a diverse range of high-quality wines to the Berkeley community. Includes food for immediate consumption as incidental use, does not exceed 3,000 square feet.
